verses.text: A Psalm. O sing to the LORD a new song, For He has done wonderful things, His right hand and His holy arm have gained the victory for Him.
verses.textZh: （一篇詩。）你們要向耶和華唱新歌！因為他行過奇妙的事；他的右手和聖臂施行救恩。

verses.text: The LORD has made known His salvation; He has revealed His righteousness in the sight of the nations.
verses.textZh: 耶和華發明了他的救恩，在列邦人眼前顯出公義；

verses.text: He has remembered His lovingkindness and His faithfulness to the house of Israel; All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.textZh: 記念他向以色列家所發的慈愛，所憑的信實。地的四極都看見我們神的救恩。

verses.text: Shout joyfully to the LORD, all the earth; Break forth and sing for joy and sing praises.
verses.textZh: 全地都要向耶和華歡樂；要發起大聲，歡呼歌頌！

verses.text: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, With the lyre and the sound of melody.
verses.textZh: 要用琴歌頌耶和華，用琴和詩歌的聲音歌頌他！

verses.text: With trumpets and the sound of the horn Shout joyfully before the King, the LORD.
verses.textZh: 用號和角聲，在大君王耶和華面前歡呼！

verses.text: Let the sea roar and all it contains, The world and those who dwell in it.
verses.textZh: 願海和其中所充滿的澎湃；世界和住在其間的也要發聲。

verses.text: Let the rivers clap their hands, Let the mountains sing together for joy
verses.textZh: 願大水拍手；願諸山在耶和華面前一同歡呼；

verses.text: Before the LORD, for He is coming to judge the earth; He will judge the world with righteousness And the peoples with equity.
verses.textZh: 因為他來要審判遍地。他要按公義審判世界，按公正審判萬民。
